title: Taiwan indicts a former TSMC executive for allegedly stealing trade secrets, in what authorities say is the first National Security Act case involving China (Cheng Ting-Fang/Nikkei Asia)
summary: Cheng Ting-Fang / Nikkei Asia: Taiwan indicts a former TSMC executive for allegedly stealing trade secrets, in what authorities say is the first National Security Act case involving China — TAIPEI — Taiwanese prosecutors on Monday indicted a former TSMC deputy manager for allegedly stealing trade secrets involving …
